---
title: "Assignment 10"
---

Begin to think about your [research project](research-project.qmd).

- What general topics interest you?
- What sort of datasets seem appropriate?

Survey data are awesome for this project. If that seems fun, then the [ANES](https://electionstudies.org), [GSS](https://gss.norc.org), and [WVS](https://www.worldvaluessurvey.org/wvs.jsp) are great places to start.

If you are interested in country-level data, [Gapminder](https://www.gapminder.org/tools/#$chart-type=bubbles&url=v2) has a great tool to start exploring.

I'm happy to chat about other datasets.
